title: A two-stage stochastic programming framework for oil and gas exploration well portfolio optimization under geological and economic uncertainty
summary: Annual oil and gas exploration planning involves selecting a limited portfolio of drilling and appraisal-related projects before geological outcomes are known. This decision is affected by uncertainties in geological success, reserve size, and economic value, while also subject to budget, well-count, success-rate, and reserve-reliability requirements. A strategy based only on expected value is therefore insufficient, as early drilling results may change the value of subsequent follow-up opportunities.
